scenes.narration: Norda Pods Mini. Two weeks on the waitlist for a box this small.
scenes.visual: Close-up of hands holding a small matte forest-green product box with the word NORDA embossed in silver on the lid, plain light-wood desk background, soft daylight, vertical video

scenes.narration: Magnetic lid. Heavy for its size. That's usually a good sign.
scenes.visual: Close-up of thumbs lifting the magnetic lid off the matte forest-green NORDA box, revealing a pebble-shaped charging case seated in cream molded paper, soft daylight, vertical video

scenes.narration: The case is this soft-touch speckled grey. Feels like a beach stone.
scenes.visual: Macro close-up of fingertips rotating a small pebble-shaped speckled grey earbud charging case, showing its soft matte texture and a thin silver seam, soft daylight, vertical video

scenes.narration: Inside: the buds. Forest green stems, silver tips, tiny N logo.
scenes.visual: Macro close-up of the speckled grey case hinged open revealing two small forest-green earbuds with polished silver tips nestled inside, soft daylight glinting off the silver, vertical video

scenes.narration: For scale: smaller than a house key. Lightest buds I've held.
scenes.visual: Close-up of an open palm holding one tiny forest-green earbud next to a standard brass house key for size comparison, the earbud clearly smaller, plain desk background, vertical video

scenes.narration: Three tip sizes in the box. Mediums sealed perfectly first try.
scenes.visual: Close-up of fingers holding three graduated pairs of soft silicone ear tips in white, arranged small to large on the light-wood desk beside the green NORDA box, vertical video

scenes.narration: First impressions: premium box, tiny buds, huge case magnet. Sound test tomorrow.
scenes.visual: Overhead flat-lay of the complete unboxed set neatly arranged: green NORDA box, speckled grey case open with green and silver earbuds, ear tips, on the light-wood desk, vertical video
